# SysML toolkit JSON fixture

`bigger.sysml` is copied from [Open-MBEE/sysml-sdk](https://github.com/Open-MBEE/sysml-sdk/blob/main/data/bigger.sysml),
which is distributed under the Apache License 2.0 (see that repository's `LICENSE`).
`bigger.full.json` was generated with sysmlv2 0.10.0:

```sh
sysmlv2 convert bigger.sysml --to full-json -o bigger.full.json
```
